title: Events and Announcements
body:
Latest Campus Updates

Stay informed about the vibrant life at Amer Maharaja P.G. College. From academic milestones to extracurricular triumphs, our campus is always buzzing with activity. For the 2026-27 academic session, we are pleased to announce that admissions are now officially open across all streams, including Arts, Science, and Commerce.

1.jpg,2.jpg,3.jpg

Academic and Cultural Events

Our calendar is filled with events designed for holistic development. Recent highlights include our National Seminar on Science and our spirited Independence Day celebrations. We also host annual National Service Scheme (NSS) camps, such as the 'Swachh Bharat' initiative, where students contribute actively to community welfare and environmental awareness.

Sports and Achievements

sports1.jpg,sports2.jpg,sports3.jpg

Excellence at Amer Maharaja P.G. College extends beyond the classroom. We take great pride in our students' athletic achievements, including our College Cricket Team's recent trophy victory. Our Annual Sports Meet remains a cornerstone of the college experience, fostering teamwork, discipline, and a healthy competitive spirit among our scholars.

Important Notices

Students are advised to regularly check the notice board for critical updates regarding practical examinations and academic schedules. The 2026 Holiday List has been updated and is available for reference to help students plan their semester effectively.
